lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the July 15 HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale preliminary public hearings covering a cluster of new buildings in Backman Village, and that's exactly the kind of project where showing up matters. The same day, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments, one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots, both the sort of quiet code changes that shape the valley for years. HARC also reviews accessibility and addition work at Town Hall and the Parks & Rec building, and the Open Space Commission hosts a Valley Floor weed pull Sunday at 4 PM with public comment open.

notable.stake: Public hearings on major multi-building Carhenge redevelopment in Backman Village.
BOCC votes on Land Use Code changes for psychedelic businesses and nonconforming lots.
HARC reviews alterations and a floor-area addition to two Town-owned landmark buildings.
Valley Floor site walk includes open public comment — a rare chance to speak on-site.
